stories.title: Suspicious package closes road near Pejepscot boat ramp in Topsham
stories.summary: The town sent an alert through its RAVE system Monday, asking people to avoid the area just south of the boat ramp on Lewiston Road, which is also Route 196.

stories.title: Overheated electrical circuit causes Fort Fairfield apartment fire
stories.summary: Two residents were displaced, according to officials.

stories.title: Smoke alarms prevents deaths of two people in North Yarmouth house fire
stories.summary: Two people escaped an early morning house fire in North Yarmouth on Saturday after smoke alarms alerted them to the flames. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: Officals warn of fake tax notice in Medford
stories.summary: A notice about a tax raise on mailboxes has been circulating on social media

stories.title: More than a milestone: What the history of co-education at Bates College can teach us today
stories.summary: Bates College was the first in New England to admit women. Now, centuries later, there are still lessons to learn about what true inclusion in education means.

stories.title: Improperly discarded woodstove ashes cause Oxford house fire
stories.summary: Firefighters arrived to find flames spreading throughout the single-family home, officials said.

stories.title: L.L.Bean warns of fake Noah Kahan event ticket scam
stories.summary: The company said the listing was a scam and had no affiliation with L.L.Bean. No such event is scheduled to take place at the flagship campus.

stories.title: 'Chickadeeds': How Maine teens are giving back to their communities
stories.summary: More than 60 teens are volunteering with nonprofits across southern Maine, helping neighbors in need while gaining a new perspective through the group Chickadeeds.

stories.title: South Portland closes City Hall, library amid suspected cyberattack
stories.summary: Initial information suggests the incident may involve activity by bad actors, according to the city.

stories.title: Crews keep Turner garage fire from reaching nearby home
stories.summary: The garage was fully engulfed in flames, with the fire threatening a neighboring residence, according to officials.

stories.title: Westbrook residents work to 'Stuff-A-Bus' with cash and food for families in need
stories.summary: The annual fundraiser filled two buses with food and have gathered $1,300 so far to support families who rely on school lunches over the vacation seasons.
